title: Release Conditions for Wound Care Supply Program Refills
content:
# Release conditions for refills on the Wound Care Supply Program

Fulfillment release rule for dressing refills on a wound care program.

## Conditions of release

1. **Program status.** A refill ships only while the program is active; a program in referral received, pending authorization, on hold or closed receives no refill.
2. **Authorization drawn.** Each refill draws on one authorization grant of the program, recorded on the shipment, and the ship date must be on or before the valid-through date on the authorization being drawn.
3. **Units available.** The units shipped may not exceed the program's authorized units remaining.
4. **Supply days.** The supply days of a shipment are the tier's days of supply per shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain; the units and pieces follow from the supply days under the dressing quantity limits of the Wound Care Supply Program.
5. **Customer confirmation.** On tiers where each refill requires the customer's confirmation, the refill ships only after the customer personally confirms, for this shipment, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand; the confirmation date is recorded on the shipment, Larkfield never ships those tiers automatically, and Larkfield's own refill reminder for those tiers is made no sooner than the tier's refill reminder lead, in calendar days, before the planned ship date. On the Wound Care Self-Pay Program refills ship on the subscription schedule without a per-shipment confirmation.
6. **Not too early.** The next refill of the same item ships no earlier than the tier's refill ship lead, in calendar days, before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item, counted in calendar days: the previous refill's ship date plus its supply days gives the end of its supply, the earliest permitted ship date is the refill ship lead before that end date, and shipping on that earliest date is allowed. A replacement shipment never counts as the previous refill.
7. **Coverage recently verified.** The coverage record the program bills must have been verified with the payer within the tier's coverage reverification period, in calendar months before the ship date, as shown by the coverage record's last verified date; the Wound Care Self-Pay Program has no coverage to verify.
8. **Inpatient stays.** On tiers where an inpatient hold is required, nothing ships while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility; the program is held under the hold rules of the Wound Care Supply Program.

The confirmation in clause 5 is the customer's own statement; the other conditions are read from the program, its authorization grants, its shipments and the coverage record.

## Earliest ship date (hypothetical figures)

Previous refill of the item shipped 2026-03-02 with 30 supply days; refill ship lead of 5 days.

- End of supply: 2026-03-02 plus 30 days is 2026-04-01.
- Earliest permitted ship date: 5 days before 2026-04-01, that is 2026-03-27.

| Proposed ship date | Permitted |
|---|---|
| 2026-03-27 | Yes — the earliest date itself is allowed |
| 2026-03-26 | No — earlier than the earliest permitted date |

## Coverage verification (hypothetical figures)

Ship date 2026-07-15 on a tier with a coverage reverification period of 6 months: a last verified date of 2026-01-15 is within 6 calendar months before the ship date; a last verified date of 2026-01-14 is not.
